title: HB1164 (2025 Regular): Constitutional Carry of Handgun

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Colorado) (gun-policy Stage 5, Colorado); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Colorado text (Introduced (02/03/2025), 2025-02-03; official copy, https://content.leg.colorado.gov/sites/default/files/documents/2025A/bills/2025a_1164_01.pdf)
provenance.note: Introduced version 02/03/2025; no passage vote on file. Later amendments are not in the text read. Lower-case words in Sections 9 and 10 (amended sections) may be struck; check the page image. Section 14 repeals 18-12-209 (temporary emergency permit) and Section 16 repeals 18-12-211 (renewal); the local-authority repeal is described in the bill summary and in later sections not quoted here.

operative_text:
Section 1 (C.R.S. 18-12-105(3)(a)): A PERSON WHO IS AT LEAST EIGHTEEN YEARS OF AGE AND IS PERMITTED TO POSSESS A HANDGUN PURSUANT TO FEDERAL AND STATE LAW HAS THE SAME AUTHORITY TO CARRY A CONCEALED HANDGUN, AND IS SUBJECT TO THE SAME LIMITATIONS, AS A PERSON WHO HOLDS A PERMIT TO CARRY A CONCEALED HANDGUN, AS SET FORTH IN SECTION 18-12-214.
Section 1 (C.R.S. 18-12-105(3)(b)): NOTHING IN THIS SUBSECTION (3) PROHIBITS A PERSON FROM APPLYING FOR AND OBTAINING A PERMIT TO CARRY A CONCEALED HANDGUN PURSUANT TO PART 2 OF THIS ARTICLE 12 FOR THE PURPOSE OF USING THE PERMIT TO CARRY A CONCEALED HANDGUN IN A STATE THAT RECOGNIZES THE VALIDITY OF A PERMIT ISSUED IN COLORADO.
Section 9 (C.R.S. 18-12-203(1)(b)): Is twenty-one EIGHTEEN years of age or older;
Section 10 (C.R.S. 18-12-204(1)(b)): A permit is valid for a period of five years after the date of issuance and may be renewed as provided in section 18-12-211 THE LIFE OF THE PERMIT HOLDER UNLESS SUSPENDED OR REVOKED.
Section 10 (C.R.S. 18-12-204(1)(c)): A PERMIT, OTHER THAN A TEMPORARY EMERGENCY PERMIT, ISSUED PURSUANT TO THIS PART 2 PRIOR TO THE EFFECTIVE DATE OF THIS SUBSECTION (1)(c) THAT IS VALID ON THE EFFECTIVE DATE OF THIS SUBSECTION (1)(c) DOES NOT EXPIRE AND IS VALID FOR THE LIFE OF THE PERMIT HOLDER UNLESS SUSPENDED OR REVOKED.
